BLOK.description: Base CTD profile sampling interval used in upper

PB1.description: Number of CTD targets in upper

PB2.description: Number of CTD targets in mid

Cyc0.description: Number of Cycles to perform in subcycle 0

Cyc1.description: Number of Cycles to perform in subcycle 1

Cyc2.description: Number of Cycles to perform in subcycle 2

Tlast0.description: pumping to target drift pressure in subcycle 0

Tlast1.description: pumping to target drift pressure in subcycle 1

Tlast2.description: pumping to target drift pressure in subcycle 2

Rise0.description: Rise time from profile depth in subcycle 0

Rise1.description: Rise time from profile depth in subcycle 1

Rise2.description: Rise time from profile depth in subcycle 2

Fall0.description: Fall time to drift depth in subcycle 0

Fall1.description: Fall time to drift depth in subcycle 1

Fall2.description: Fall time to drift depth in subcycle 2

SAMmn0.description: Time between drift samples in subcycle 0

SAMmn1.description: Time between drift samples in subcycle 1

SAMmn2.description: Time between drift samples in subcycle 2

Nsam0.description: Number of drift samples in subcycle 0

Nsam1.description: Number of drift samples to subcycle 1

Nsam2.description: Number of drift samples to subcycle 2

Pwait0.description: Time to wait to fall from drift to profile in subcycle 0

Pwait1.description: Time to wait to fall from drift to profile in subcycle 1

Pwait2.description: Time to wait to fall from drift to profile in subcycle 2

PmpBtm.description: Time of buoyancy pump at start of profile

MinRis.description: Minimum ascent rate resulting in intermediate pump

VlvDly.description: time after motor starts to close valve in startSBEpro

MnSfP.description: Min sec to run pump @ surface

MxSfP.description: Max time to pump at the surface

mxSeek.description: max pump time for 1 seek cycle

Nseek.description: Number of seek periods targeting drift pressure

STLmin.description: Time to allow float to settle at drift pressure after seek pump

TlstCF.description: Percentage of learning of amount to pump targeting drift

Ventsc.description: Max time[s] to run the air vent

Ventop.description: =0 do nothing,=1 report LLD output,=2 run vent

SkSLsc.description: Time between descending P, time pairs

AsSLsc.description: Time between ascending P, time pairs and ascent rate estimation

Ndives.description: Total number of dives over the mission

CTDofZ.description: Depth to stop the CTD pump

SrfDft.description: surface drift=1 for lat (NS),2 for lon (EW), 3 for both, 0 for none

SrfMxN.description: Max number of iterations of surface drift

UBZmax.description: Depth to start sending raw scans

DrfDat.description: Enable collection of data at drift

IceIn.description: Number of true ice-algorithm cycle prior to fully entering ice-mode

IceOut.description: Number of false ice-algorithm cycles prior to exiting full ice-mode

XP0.description: Manual running of buoyancy pump at end of drift

XP1.description: Manual running of buoyancy pump at end of pwait

XP2.description: Manual running of buoyancy pump at the start of profile

XP0dZ.description: Depth falling past drift depth before pumping

OILvac.description: Max vacuum on oil feed line

Z1Pump.description: Depth of 1st pump on descent (pump TlastX s)

DiveNo.description: Integer to start incrementing cycle number
